sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
DesignNBuy is a software company offering web-to-print solutions that help print and packaging businesses sell customized products online with automated pricing, personalization, ordering, and production workflows.

Industry: Software · Size: <$50M · Products: DesignO, Web-to-Print Platform, Online Design Editor, 3D Product Previews, Order Management System, Job Management

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: DesignNBuy scores 37 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by application fit (25/25) and event engagement (8/15). Nothing was found for industry fit and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Drytac (30% similar on print, display, graphics, commercial); Mactac (16% similar on print, printing, signage, commercial). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
• Flags on the record: size third party estimate
